title: 정정보도청구 등 사건 심판규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Enforcement)
(1) A stay of enforcement of a judgment in a case concerning a request for a corrective report, etc. shall follow the procedures prescribed in Article 309 of the Civil Execution Act.
(2) Article 292 (2) of the Civil Execution Act shall not apply to enforcement of a judgment in a case concerning a request for a corrective report, etc.
(3) Where the respondent publishes or broadcasts the contents of a corrective report, reply report, or subsequent report pursuant to a judgment ordering such publication or broadcast, the respondent shall notify the applicant and the competent trial division within five days of that fact.
